messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 billing/metering anomaly detected — token_count drift + delayed usage emits from aggregator. Multiple overage flags fired for a subset of accounts in us-east-1. Paging @dan-oncall.

dan-oncall: I see the alerts. opening runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/metering-emit. Assigning bob-sre + frank-eng.

bob-sre: looking at consumer lag and emitter commits now. quick check: consumer groups look healthy but emitter commit timestamps have gaps.

carla-billing: we've had 5 customer overage notifications in the last 10m. can we pause outgoing billing alerts while we triage? :grimacing:

eve-support: triage: 3 tickets already, customers asking if charges are real. I'll add a temporary canned response.

frank-eng: hypothesis: aggregator applied batches out-of-order due to a downstream backfill/replay. replays could cause transient double-counting or delayed emits. checking batch ids and delivery timestamps.

bob-sre: run of `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-aggregator` shows LAG=0 on active partitions, but `emitter-commit` service logs show commit offsets jumping. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:11:58Z emitter INFO published batch id=abc123 count=0 ack delayed
2026-03-17T10:12:05Z aggregator INFO applied batch id=abc123 t_diff=7.2s
```

dan-oncall: plan: 1) mute billing alert webhook for the affected account set for 15m, 2) flip routing to emitter-v2-fallback, 3) kick recon job to reconcile batch ids and reemit idempotently. @carla-billing ok to mute?

carla-billing: agree, mute for impacted customers. escalate if unresolved at +30m. I'll draft a crediting policy if overcharges confirmed.

geeta-cs: preparing customer banner: "We detected metering anomalies affecting some overage notifications. We're investigating and will reconcile any incorrect charges." Will send to top customers after approval.

frank-eng: started reconciliation job for window 10:05-10:12. reemit in idempotent mode to avoid duplicates. ETA ~18m.

eve-support: updating ticket queue and posting temporary message to affected customers. adding incident ref INC-391827.

dan-oncall: switching routing to emitter-v2-fallback now. status: applied.

incident-bot: action log: routing_switch applied by dan-oncall at 10:15Z. next_check scheduled 10:30Z.

bob-sre: monitoring token-delta dashboards. observed drop in anomalous token spikes ~60% after routing switch (4m).

frank-eng: reconciliation completed for target window. pushed reconciliation report to /incidents/391827/recon.csv. Doing diff vs billing accounting. Initial pass shows ~0.9% of customers had transient extra tokens flagged.

carla-billing: unmuted alerts for non-impacted accounts. keeping mute for impacted set until we finish reconciliation. preparing list for auto-crediting.

geeta-cs: banner posted, 4 customers asked for status calls — scheduling. customers appreciate proactive note.

dan-oncall: created follow-up tasks: FR-391827 (alert guard for emitter-lag), PM-391827 (postmortem). Owners: frank-eng (lead), bob-sre (infra), carla-billing (customer ops).

alice-product: suggestion: add suppression rule in alerting to ignore overage-alerts when emitter-lag is < 30s and reconciliation pending. filing feature request.

frank-eng: will include both short-term mitigation (mute + fallback) and long-term fix (idempotent emitter guarantees + alert suppression) in postmortem. patch queued.

dan-oncall: incident downgraded to P2 while we monitor reconciliation. keep channel updated if deltas reappear.

incident-bot: Incident INC-391827 status: mitigated -> follow-ups created. close at 10:41Z.
